description: Utility functions for generating SMS messages with booking details, handling attendee selection, and determining whether to use Twilio based on trigger timing.

methods.name: getSMSMessageWithVariables
methods.description: Generates a customized SMS message with booking details, including shortened URLs and localized time information.

methods.name: getAttendeeToBeUsedInSMS
methods.description: Selects the appropriate attendee for SMS based on action and available contact information.

methods.name: shouldUseTwilio
methods.description: Determines whether to use Twilio for messaging based on trigger timing and scheduled date.
